name: Grove of the Ancients
summary: A dispatch carries you from Darnassus to Darkshore, where Onu waits in the Grove of the Ancients. Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm sends you across the sea with correspondence for the Ancient of Lore, who lives south of Auberdine.

sections.title: Leaving the Boughs
sections.body: After you help with matters at the Oracle Glade atop Teldrassil, Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm summons you for another duty. He sends you across the sea to Darkshore with an urgent dispatch for Onu. From Darnassus, you can book a flight aboard a hippogryph.

sections.title: A Contrast in Patience
sections.body: South of Auberdine, you reach the Grove of the Ancients and deliver the missive to Onu. The towering Ancient of Lore accepts it quietly and remarks on Staghelm's impatience. Onu and the forest's ancient keepers believe all things unfold in their proper time. Shan'do Malfurion Stormrage embodied that patient wisdom, while Staghelm lacks it.

faq.q: Who starts the quest Grove of the Ancients?
aliases: quest giver grove of the ancients
faq.answer: Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm sends you from the Cenarion Enclave in Darnassus after you complete his earlier errand concerning the Oracle Glade.

faq.q: Where is the Grove of the Ancients located?
faq.answer: The Grove of the Ancients lies on the mainland in Darkshore, directly south of the coastal port of Auberdine.
Onu is a wise and venerable Ancient of Lore in Darkshore. He protects and records natural wisdom, and receives correspondence from Darnassus's druidic leadership.

faq.q: How do you reach Darkshore from Teldrassil?
faq.answer: From Darnassus, travel to Rut'theran Village and take a hippogryph across the water to Auberdine, Darkshore's port settlement.

faq.q: Why does Onu mention Shan'do Stormrage?
faq.answer: Onu remarks on Arch Druid Staghelm's restless haste after receiving the missive. He says the forest moves at its own pace, with a patience Shan'do Malfurion Stormrage understood and respected.

faq.q: What quests come before this one?
faq.answer: This is the last step in a short sequence of three parts. It begins with The Enchanted Glade, continues with Teldrassil, then sends you out to Darkshore.

angles.text: As a Night Elf, you leave Teldrassil's sheltered cradle for the wider wilds of mainland Kalimdor. The journey shows the contrast between Fandral Staghelm and Malfurion Stormrage's teachings.
As a druid, you carry a missive between Darnassus's Arch Druid and Onu. Their different temperaments show Staghelm's drive beside an Ancient of Lore's quiet patience.
As an Alliance champion, you leave your business in Darnassus with reason to secure hippogryph routes and explore Darkshore's coast.
